name: Inlet block (flanged, spooled treating line)
function: The flanged block above the crown valve with a side hub where the spooled treating line from the zipper manifold enters the stack.

tabs.overview: A studded block with the vertical bore and one flanged outlet. A single large-bore flanged spool or monoline swivel assembly connects it to the zipper module, replacing the goat head and the bundle of 3 in. hammer-union iron. Fewer connections means fewer leak paths and a faster rig-up, at the cost of heavier pieces that need a crane.
tabs.engineering: Block and hub sized to the stack bore and rating; the outlet flange matches the treating spool.
tabs.safety: The inlet block sees full treating pressure and proppant erosion at the turn; wall thickness is checked between jobs.
tabs.evidence: Field photographs read for proportion only; public flange tables (S16); field practice (S9).

hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
